decision_scope: The focused 2026-08-28 evidence window for Liuyao and Meihua OSS ChartProvider candidates; this is not a permanent ban on future candidates.
decision_rationale: The Liuyao candidate has useful mechanical coverage but its exact distribution, transitive provenance, and license evidence are not closed, and required mutual/opposite/reverse relations are absent.
The Meihua candidate has an exact MIT release but does not implement the current five-method input contract and has deterministic chart-name and no-moving-line failures visible in the tagged source.
Neither candidate is eligible to replace the current self-owned migration oracle or become a second production fact source.

ming_65.interpretation: Temporary engineering state pending a qualified candidate, not a permanent architecture exception.

ming_66.admission_rule: License admission is independent of Provider coverage; runtime promotion requires an exact artifact/ref, complete local/upstream license evidence, and closed distribution obligations.
ming_66.sxtwl_status: HOLD: 2.0.7 sdist has no license member and no exact upstream ref binds the BSD-3-Clause text to that artifact.

baseline.canonical_rule: Owned Request Compiler and Time/Policy Normalizer -> Runtime Provider -> licensed pinned OSS Chart Engine -> Engine Adapter -> per-art Canonical Facts. Runtime Canonical Facts remain the only external fact truth; third-party raw objects remain private.

synthetic_differential.first_failure_gate: Stop on the first mismatch in primary/mutual/changed identity, line order, moving lines, Najia/Shi-Ying/six-relatives/six-spirits/Xunkong, body/use, method provenance, or owned calendar identity. Missing required facts, a fail-open fallback, unresolved license provenance, or any raw-object leak is also an immediate failure.
single_fact_source_cutover_gate: Close candidate license/provenance and immutable-version evidence first.
Run the candidate only behind a private Engine Adapter in shadow mode; current self-owned Canonical Facts remain authoritative.
Pass all selected existing Goldens and boundaries without changing expected values; classify every accepted difference as an explicit Adapter normalization or owned policy difference.
Emit the existing per-art Canonical Facts with third-party raw objects removed and owned policy/evidence layers unchanged.

Switch one versioned Provider configuration atomically, retain old fixtures as regression evidence, and remove/disable the parallel self-owned production mechanical path so only one chart engine supplies facts.
Rollback on any post-switch mismatch, missing fact, provenance drift, or release-closure failure.

next_action.recommended_follow_up: Keep both Providers self-owned as migration oracles. Open a new evidence-only admission task only when an upstream release closes the listed legal and mechanical gaps or when a different focused candidate is identified; do not keep an implementation slot open meanwhile.
